vocab.meaning_vi: trình diễn, giới thiệu nổi bật

vocab.example: Let me walk you through the user journey from sign-up to checkout.

vocab.example: Let us rehearse the demo once before the client joins.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta tập dượt buổi demo một lần trước khi khách hàng vào.

vocab.example: If the server is slow, our backup plan is a recorded video.
vocab.example_vi: Nếu server chậm, kế hoạch dự phòng của chúng ta là một video quay sẵn.

vocab.example: We reduced the load time of the home page to one second.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi đã giảm thời gian tải trang chủ xuống còn một giây.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Product Owner)
lines.text: Hi Quân. Are you ready for the live demo with the client at three?

lines.speaker: Quân (Developer)
lines.text: Almost. I want to rehearse it once more. The new dashboard still feels a bit slow.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Product Owner)
lines.text: How slow? The client really cares about load time.

lines.speaker: Quân (Developer)
lines.text: About three seconds on the first open. After that, it is under one second.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Product Owner)
lines.text: Okay. Can you open it once before the meeting so it is already fast?

lines.speaker: Quân (Developer)
lines.text: Good idea. I will also run everything in the sandbox, so we do not touch real data.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Product Owner)
lines.text: Great. What will you showcase first?

lines.speaker: Quân (Developer)
lines.text: I will follow the user journey: login, create an order, then check it on the dashboard.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Product Owner)
lines.text: Perfect. And if the connection fails?

lines.speaker: Quân (Developer)
lines.text: Our backup plan is a short recorded video. I saved it on my desktop.

options: The dashboard is a bit slow on the first open
